verdict.rationale: Lovable's docs describe two built-in security scanners, Basic scan and Deep scan, plus optional connectors, and enterprise adds scheduled Deep scans and workspace-wide security oversight. That is the platform itself reviewing the generated app for security issues. Community skepticism about users' security awareness is not concrete evidence that the scanners fail. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that scans run or gate before publishing, detail on what each scan checks, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have the platform review my generated app for security issues before it goes live

citations.quote: Lovable includes two built-in security scanners, Basic scan and Deep scan, plus optional connectors for additional coverage.
workspace-wide security oversight, scheduled Deep scans
